conditionalFormatting: Not supported — loop and set format per cell.
Array dimension mismatch: Range R×C needs R inner arrays of C elements. Merged ranges still require the full original R×C array size (e.g. A1:F1 is [[v,'','','','','']]).
EdgeAround Border Error: Property 'EdgeAround' is not supported in getItem(). Loop through ['EdgeTop', 'EdgeBottom', 'EdgeLeft', 'EdgeRight'] instead.
numberFormat on Single Cell vs Range: On a single cell (via getCell), use a string: '0.00'. On a Range, use a 2-D array: [['0.00','0.00']].
range.getRow(): Does not exist — use sheet.getRange('A1:Z1') with explicit address
Missing ctx.sync(): Call await ctx.sync() before returning to flush queued operations
getLastCell().getEnd(): getEnd() not on Range — use sheet.getUsedRange()+load('rowCount') for last row
dataValidation source format: Source must be a range reference starting with '=' (e.g., '=Sheet1!$A$1:$A$5'). Comma-separated strings are not supported.
VLOOKUP formula on multi-row range: Assign one formula per row: range.formulas=rows.map((_,i)=>[ `=VLOOKUP(D${i+2},...)` ])
forEach with multiple ctx.sync: Batch all operations first, then one ctx.sync() at the end
